description:
Surface the existing deployment-manager approval-gating backend through real operator-facing UI and CLI flows.

The work should make it practical to:
- configure required platforms per profile
- inspect approval state by commit/platform/profile
- create pending approvals when appropriate
- review blocked release-gate status without dropping to ad hoc API calls

This is intentionally about surfacing and completing an existing capability, not inventing a second approval system.
name: deployment-manager-approval-gate-surfaces
note: Wait until test genie failures are all fixed for deployment manager
title: Expose Approval Gate Controls In Deployment Manager
